String: You felt like a smooth, beautiful <dolphin/manta ray/shark/porpoise/manatee/beluga>.
You felt the ache in your <body-part> fade blissfully away.
You felt <num20-30> years younger.
It felt like you had just bathed in the fountain of youth.
You felt as though your <joints/muscles/legs/arms> were regenerating in real time.
You felt like you could <run a marathon/complete a triathlon/compete in the Olympics/take on the Ironman>.
You felt like a Na'vi reconnecting with Eywa.
You felt ready for <a whole day of bingo/a long walk in the park/a long night of board games/a long book club session>.
You felt like you could star in <an Adidas/a Nike/a New Balance/a Puma/an Under Armour/an ASICS/a Vans> commercial.
You felt like a <hedgehog/bear/chipmunk/bat>, emerging from a long slumber.
You felt like an athlete stepping onto the <field/pitch/track/ice/court> for the first time.
You felt like a kid <in a candy shop/in a toy store/at an amusement park/in a ballpit/on a swing set/in a treehouse>.
You felt like a freshly picked <tomato/turnip/apple/carrot/cucumber/squash/pear/plum>.
You felt like a baby in a <blanket/swaddle/quilt/wrap/warm hug>.
You felt like you just won at <bingo/bridge/Parcheesi/checkers/chess/Scrabble/dominoes/backgammon>.
You felt <like a million bucks/fit as a fiddle/like you were on top of the world/like you were walking on air/like you were walking on sunshine>.
You felt <the fear of death/the effects of time/the decay of your body/the weight of the years/the aches and pains of age> wash away.
You felt reborn, like a <phoenix/butterfly/lotus flower/dragonfly/spring flower>.
You felt like a teen at <prom night/homecoming/a school dance/a roller rink/a sleepover>.
You felt like <you made your doctor proud/you bought yourself a few more years/you reminded everyone at the Senior Center how young you feel/you proved age is just a number/you beat the Grim Reaper>.
You felt like <Lionel Messi/Cristiano Ronaldo/LeBron James/Tom Brady>, full of energy and never past your prime.
You felt like a <shark/cheetah/panther/puma/lion/hawk>, prowling with renewed vigor.
